changes: United country and six requested region geometries; Albers equal-area projection; antimeridian unwrapped; simplified 2.5 km at country scale; small dataset seams closed at 1.8 km; uniform scale only, no stroke, very light grey fill.
boundaryConvention: Requested depiction follows Russian territorial claims, including Crimea, Sevastopol and the full Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions; it is not a map of international recognition or current military control.
